text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I am truly sorry...
I wasn't strong enough, I really am...
choice_data_list: Some races just don't go your way.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I really hate the thought of... Trainer being looked down upon because of my losses.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: The only reason we lost was because I was too weak...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I... don't want to lose anymore.
To help my Trainer shine,
I can't afford to hesitate any longer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Before this resolve wavers...
Once more—I ask for your
strict guidance, please—
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's figure out a way to win together.
Yeah, let's think of a way to win together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Before this resolve wavers...
Once more—I ask for your
strict guidance, please—
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's figure out a way to win together.
Yeah, let's think of a way to win together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: Let's start over again. Together, the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...You are truly kind through and through,
aren't you... Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why—
I want to repay that kindness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Once more... I'll be in your care.
Next time, I promise I'll deliver results.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
Your guidance, Trainer-san, is truly reliable――

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That is something—I believe I understand
better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That is why—I must make the most of it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my absolute best as well...
So that next time—I can bring you victory.
